ALPHA GUIDE 
Page 24 of 76 
 
 
“This means that anyone who belongs to Christ has become a new  
person. The old life is gone; a new life has begun!”  (2 Corinthians 5:17, NLT) 
 
A Christian is a Christ-ian: someone who follows and puts their faith in Jesus Christ. 
 
How that happens varies enormously. For some there is a definite moment; for others it 
is a more gradual process. 
 
• When you receive Christ, you become a child of God. (John 1:12)  
• God wants you to be sure of your faith. 
 
“I write these things 
 to you who believe in 
 the name of the Son 
 of God so that you 
 may know that you   
 have eternal life.”  
(1 JOHN 5:13) 
Faith is not a blind leap, but a step based on evidence.
